title: Pawn skills with Skill Creator + Dullahan + _NickCore + UDD2P installed (DPC 0.9.175-dev1)
intro: Two players report pawn skills not working; one uses the Dullahan and Skill Creator mods. Those mods (and _NickCore, UDD2P that Dullahan needs) are now installed next to DPC. RESTART THE GAME before this test (Skill Creator wants a restart), and SAVE first. Outdoors, playing the Arisen, co-op off, three pawns. Don't buy or equip any new Dullahan skills unless a step asks. For each pawn: a training dummy stands ahead; use each of its 4 skills once with L1 + a face button (wait for each to finish). About 5 minutes. Press End to start.

steps.text: 1/4 You play your MAIN pawn. Use all 4 of its skills on the dummy (L1 + each face button). If one doesn't fire, try it twice more. End when done.

expect.label: equipped skill ids (over 131 = added by a mod)

steps.text: 2/4 Now your SECOND pawn. Same: all 4 skills on the dummy. End when done.

expect.label: equipped skill ids (over 131 = added by a mod)

steps.text: 3/4 Now your THIRD pawn. Same: all 4 skills. End when done.

expect.label: equipped skill ids (over 131 = added by a mod)

steps.text: 4/4 Done, back to the Arisen. Tell Claude which skills (pawn, button) didn't fire, if any. End to finish.

probes.who: local D=_G.DPC_dbg; return D and (D.state.active and ('playing '..tostring(D.state.pawn_name)) or 'Arisen') or ''
probes.ok: local D=_G.DPC_dbg; return D and (D.R.skill_ok_n or 0) or -1
probes.fail: local D=_G.DPC_dbg; return D and (D.R.skill_fail_n or 0) or -1
probes.why: local D=_G.DPC_dbg; local f=D and D.R.skill_fail_last; return f and (tostring(f.id)..' slot '..tostring(f.slot)..': '..(f.why~='' and f.why or 'no known reason')..' | '..tostring(f.node)) or 'none'
probes.mods: local D=_G.DPC_dbg; return D and D.R.skill_mods and D.R.skill_mods() or ''
probes.skills: local D=_G.DPC_dbg; if not D then return '' end; local t={}; for s=1,4 do t[#t+1]=tostring(D.state.pawn_skills and D.state.pawn_skills[s] or '-') end; return table.concat(t,',')
probes.sk_now: local D=_G.DPC_dbg; local h=D and D.state.pawn_human; local ok,v=pcall(function() return h:call('get_CustomSkillState') end); return ok and v or 0
probes.errs: local ok, d = pcall(json.load_file, 'dev_status/DirectPawnControl.json'); return ok and d and d.errors
